[[File:Trand_Cappa.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Trand Cappa'' and its giant water injector]]
The '''''Trand Cappa''''' was a [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] which served in the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|navy]] during [[Darth Wredd]]'s [[Darth Wredd's insurgency|insurgency]]. In [[139 ABY]], the tanker took part in the [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards]]. Under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s orders, the tanker was loaded with water and used to flood the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]], overwhelming the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and allowing the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to regain the upper hand.
